name: evidence-viewer-viewport
goal: Keep image controls, content and captions visible in the evidence viewer viewport.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At bfd649ff3893, mobile compare omits the after image and mobile viewport-mobile omits its caption; tablet actual-size omits its caption. Both images and captions should fit in the lightbox capture.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: explorer-shell-component-catalog.spec.ts exercises the existing realistic evidence-viewer variants but checks caption bounds only for four 920px-wide states. It misses mobile comparisons and tall or zoomed images. Check every figure image, link and caption at each viewport.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red record 99822a07baf4: the existing catalog test failed toBeInViewport for mobile compare and tall images and tablet actual size.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fit the zoom stage into the remaining lightbox space and keep comparison panels side by side.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green record e6448ff90acb: the same catalog command, fixtures and test inputs pass at the repair commit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
